aries:
♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Cancer Moon travels through Ashlesha, joining Jupiter and Mars in your 4th house of emotional roots and home. With the Sun steady in Virgo (your 6th house), there’s a strong current between your private foundations and your daily responsibilities. Ashlesha’s coiling, investigative quality can stir buried feelings about security, belonging, or family patterns, and Mars there prefers to act, not just think.

💼 Career: Work themes are coloured by what’s happening behind the scenes. If something at home or in your inner life feels wobbly, your efficiency may dip or your temper may flare at small irritations. Use the Virgo Sun’s detail focus to quietly reorganise your workflow, delegate a bit, or adjust your schedule so you’re not carrying everything at once. A practical, methodical approach to tasks will help you feel less on edge and more in control.

❤️ Love: With such a strong 4th-house emphasis, your need for emotional safety is heightened. You may feel extra sensitive to how partners or close people speak to you, especially around family or domestic topics. If partnered, this is a good day to update the “rules of the nest”: who does what, how you both handle stress, and what actually soothes you. If single, you may find yourself re-evaluating what “home” with another person should feel like, based on past experiences that resurface.

💰 Money: Mars and Jupiter in the 4th can highlight expenditures related to property, moves, repairs, or family needs. There might be an urge to make a bold improvement in your living space, but Ashlesha advises careful research first. Meanwhile, the Virgo Sun in your 6th favours modest, sensible spending on tools and services that genuinely support your work and health. Prioritise what keeps your base steady rather than flashy changes.

🧘 Advice: When you notice tension rising, tend to the container before the contents: straighten your space, drink water, breathe slowly. A small act of care for your environment will stabilise your reactions.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Strengthening the ground you stand on today quietly powers every move you’ll make tomorrow.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Ashlesha lights up your 3rd house of communication, skills, and short trips, joining Jupiter and Mars already energising that area. The Sun in Virgo continues to occupy your 5th house, supporting creativity and self-expression. This mix brings a sharp, probing mental energy: conversations go deeper, and your mind wants to get to the root of issues rather than skim the surface.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for research, strategic writing, and careful negotiation. Mars in the 3rd gives courage to speak up; Jupiter adds perspective, and Ashlesha helps you detect what’s unsaid. Use this to clarify agreements, tighten documentation, or improve how you communicate with colleagues, clients, or suppliers. Productive short trips, calls, or online meetings can move a project forward, especially if you prepare your points in detail.

❤️ Love: Your words carry more emotional charge than you realise. The 3rd-house focus can make you more talkative, but Ashlesha’s influence suggests that tone and timing matter. If partnered, conversations about children, shared hobbies, or future plans may become more intense—aim for curiosity, not interrogation. If single, you may feel drawn to someone whose mind fascinates you; connections that start with deep, slightly mysterious conversations could feel especially magnetic.

💰 Money: Small financial decisions linked to transport, communication tools, or education are in the spotlight. You might discover forgotten charges, subscriptions, or a better deal by reading the fine print carefully. The 5th-house Sun reminds you that some spending on joy or creative pursuits is healthy, but avoid impulsive purchases triggered by mental restlessness. Let any significant commitment sit for a day if you feel pressured.

🧘 Advice: Before sending an important message or making a key call, pause and ask: “What result do I truly want from this?” Let that answer shape your words.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your speech and intentions pull in the same direction, even small conversations can quietly reshape your path.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Ashlesha moves through your 2nd house of resources, values, and speech, where Jupiter and Mars are already amplifying themes of security and self-worth. The Sun in Virgo continues to light up your 4th house, tying your financial and practical decisions closely to your home and emotional base. Your usually flexible nature may feel more protective and cautious today.

💼 Career: Work decisions are filtered through the question, “Does this feel stable for me?” The 2nd–4th house combination encourages you to consider not just status, but how your job supports your basic needs, living situation, and peace of mind. You may feel motivated to negotiate pay, refine an offer, or clearly define what you will and won’t take on. Attention to detail in contracts and compensation structures is especially supported.

❤️ Love: Emotional security is your quiet priority now. You’re likely more aware of whether a partner’s actions align with their words, especially around shared responsibilities and the atmosphere at home. If partnered, practical discussions about budgeting, living arrangements, or long-term stability can be fruitful if approached calmly. If single, you may feel less interested in casual flings and more drawn to people who feel consistent and grounded.

💰 Money: The Moon–Jupiter–Mars cluster in your 2nd house can magnify both earning potential and anxieties about money. Ashlesha’s influence is excellent for investigating: review accounts, look for leaks, or study how your skills might bring in more consistent income. Avoid making financial choices from a defensive or possessive mood; focus on building systems that make you feel less dependent on short-term swings.

🧘 Advice: Any time you feel pressured to decide quickly about money or commitments, step back and ask yourself how the choice will feel in your body a month from now—lighter or tighter.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Respecting your need for true security doesn’t limit your options; it filters out those that were never really for you.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, is in your own sign in Ashlesha, tightly linked with Jupiter and Mars also in Cancer. This concentrates a great deal of emotional and physical energy in your 1st house of self, identity, and direction. With the Sun in Virgo moving through your 3rd house, your urge to express, explain, and connect is strong—but so is your sensitivity.

💼 Career: You’re likely to feel more visible and impactful today, whether you’re seeking it or not. People may react strongly to your mood and words. The 3rd-house Virgo Sun favours precise communication: emails, reports, or presentations that combine clarity with emotional insight can land especially well. Just watch for Ashlesha’s tendency to hold onto slights; choose where to invest your energy rather than getting pulled into minor frictions.

❤️ Love: Feelings are intense and close to the surface. You may crave reassurance, but also greater emotional honesty. If partnered, this can be a day for transformative discussions—sharing deeper fears, boundaries, or desires—provided you avoid testing others through withdrawal or subtle stings. If single, your magnetism is high; others sense depth and passion in you. Take your time learning whether someone can handle that depth with care.

💰 Money: With so much focus on your 1st house, financial matters are coloured by your sense of self. You might feel driven to make purchases or commitments that symbolise a new phase—new tools, training, or personal items. The 3rd-house Sun encourages you to gather information: compare options, read reviews, and consider long-term usefulness. Avoid money moves made purely to soothe a passing emotional wave.

🧘 Advice: Give your intensity a constructive outlet: journaling, targeted exercise, or a meaningful conversation. Unexpressed emotion will look for sideways exits.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you own the depth of what you feel, you stop needing others to guess it—and your connections grow cleaner and stronger.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Ashlesha activates your 12th house of retreat, subconscious patterns, and spiritual processing, where Jupiter and Mars are also transiting. Meanwhile, the Sun—your ruler—holds steady in Virgo in your 2nd house of money and self-worth. Outwardly, the day may look normal, but internally a lot is stirring and being reviewed.

💼 Career: You may prefer working behind the scenes, tying up loose ends or quietly correcting errors rather than pushing into the spotlight. Hidden dynamics at work—unspoken expectations, invisible labour, or old resentments—may come to your attention. Use the thorough Virgo Sun in your 2nd house to focus on concrete things you can adjust: the value you place on your time, the clarity of your rates or role, and the boundaries between “helping out” and unpaid work.

❤️ Love: Old feelings, dreams, or private disappointments may surface for reevaluation. The 12th-house Moon can make you more introspective, craving gentleness rather than drama. If partnered, it’s a good day to share inner worries or lingering questions that you usually keep to yourself. If single, you might notice patterns in past connections—especially around giving more than you receive—that you’re finally ready to release.

💰 Money: The Sun in Virgo in your 2nd house keeps financial clarity at the forefront. This is a favourable day for auditing expenses, setting realistic saving targets, or defining what “enough” looks like so you don’t overextend yourself out of pride. With 12th-house activation, check for hidden or forgotten costs: subscriptions, quiet favours that have become expectations, or emotional spending to ease fatigue.

🧘 Advice: Allow yourself some unstructured quiet time, even if brief. Insights that matter most today are more likely to arrive when you’re not pushing for them.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Letting go of one quiet drain on your energy or finances now can restore more of your radiance than any grand gesture.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Ashlesha travels through your 11th house of friendships, networks, and long-term aspirations, joining Jupiter and Mars in that same sphere. The Sun remains in your own sign, in Hasta, sharpening your ability to shape plans with your hands and mind. Today’s energy supports strategic collaboration and realistic dreaming.

💼 Career: Group projects, professional communities, and alliances are activated. Mars can stir impatience with disorganised teams, while Jupiter opens doors through supportive contacts. Ashlesha’s influence allows you to read the emotional undercurrent in groups—who’s aligned, who’s resistant, where trust is strong or thin. This is a powerful day to refine a shared goal, adjust roles, or reach out to someone whose support could significantly move you forward.

❤️ Love: Social circles and wider communities may intersect with your romantic life. A friendship may feel like it’s shifting into a different kind of connection, or mutual goals with a partner may take centre stage. If partnered, discuss your respective visions for the coming year—not just in theory, but with concrete steps. If single, pay attention to who consistently shows up in group spaces; steady presence today says more than sporadic intensity.

💰 Money: The 11th house also relates to gains from your work and the fruits of previous efforts. You may see hints of how your contributions within a team could translate into future rewards—financial or otherwise. This is an excellent day to review compensation structures, bonuses, or pricing for collaborative offerings. The Sun in your 1st encourages decisions that respect your energy and expertise, even if that means modest but clear boundaries.

🧘 Advice: Choose one key goal and one key ally to focus on, rather than scattering your attention across every possibility. Depth of engagement will serve you better than breadth.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you pair your precision with the right people, your efforts stop feeling like lonely perfectionism and start becoming visible progress.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Ashlesha climbs through your 10th house of career, visibility, and public role, where Jupiter and Mars are already active. At the same time, both Mercury and Venus are in your sign in Swati, with Venus retrograde, and the Sun remains in Virgo in your 12th house. Outward recognition and inner reassessment run in parallel.

💼 Career: Your professional image is under a bright, complex spotlight. Mars pushes you to take initiative or defend your position; Jupiter can bring opportunities or expanded responsibilities. Ashlesha suggests that decisions made now have subtle, long-term implications, so avoid impulsive reactions driven by ego or hurt. With Venus retrograde in your 1st and the Sun in your introspective 12th, you’re being nudged to re-examine why you’re chasing certain goals and whether they truly reflect your deeper values.

❤️ Love: Relationships may feel tied to questions of status, timing, or life direction. You might sense that something in the balance between support and independence needs adjusting. If partnered, talking honestly about how career choices affect the relationship—time, energy, relocation possibilities—can prevent misunderstandings later. If single, you may find yourself reassessing what kind of partner fits the person you’re becoming, not who you used to be.

💰 Money: Professional finances, benefits, or long-term commitments related to work may need attention. Promotions, altered responsibilities, or changing roles could have delayed financial effects. The 12th-house Sun also points toward hidden or background costs: obligations you’ve taken on quietly or patterns of giving more than you invoice for. Subtle course corrections—like updating your rates or clarifying boundaries—will help stabilise your material base.

🧘 Advice: Before agreeing to any new responsibility or title, privately ask yourself, “What will this actually cost me in time, energy, and freedom?” Let that answer weigh as heavily as prestige.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Aligning your outer success with your inner truth may feel slow, but it’s the only path that doesn’t demand a part of you as payment later.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Ashlesha moves through your 9th house of beliefs, higher learning, and long-distance matters, alongside Jupiter and Mars in the same sign. The Sun in Virgo continues to activate your 11th house of networks and future plans. This combination pulls you toward broader horizons—intellectually, spiritually, or geographically—while also tying those horizons to community.

💼 Career: It’s an excellent day for big-picture planning. You might feel drawn to explore advanced training, specialised knowledge, or new markets that could broaden your impact. Mars gives you the push to take a step toward these possibilities—sending an application, scheduling a call with a mentor, or mapping out a long-term strategy. Ashlesha encourages you to examine the beliefs driving your ambitions: are they genuinely yours, or inherited expectations?

❤️ Love: You may crave relationships that help you grow rather than stay comfortable. Discussions about values, ethics, or the future may feel more intimate than small talk. If partnered, shared decisions about travel, education, or community involvement can strengthen the bond. If single, you might feel attracted to someone from a different culture, background, or philosophical outlook, especially through group activities or online spaces linked to learning.

💰 Money: Financial considerations may connect to education, travel, publishing, or long-range ventures. Jupiter’s presence can highlight opportunities, while Mars pushes for action; Ashlesha advises due diligence. The Virgo Sun in your 11th also encourages you to think about long-term gains and contributions rather than quick profit. Run the numbers carefully on any “expansion” idea and consider the time commitment as part of the cost.

🧘 Advice: When a familiar fear tries to keep you inside old limits, gently counter it with one grounded action that honours what you now believe is possible.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The doors that matter most often open when you dare to update your story about what you’re here to do.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Ashlesha activates your 8th house of shared resources, psychological depths, and transformation, joining Jupiter (your ruler) and Mars already there. The Sun in Virgo continues to illuminate your 10th house of career and public standing. Hidden layers and practical responsibilities intersect, making this a day to look honestly at what lies beneath your current structures.

💼 Career: Power dynamics, shared responsibilities, and long-term commitments in your professional life come into focus. You might be prompted to examine how work is divided in partnerships, who holds decision-making power, and whether arrangements still feel fair. Ashlesha’s investigative energy is useful for reviewing contracts, revenue-sharing models, or behind-the-scenes politics. Changes don’t have to be dramatic; even naming an imbalance is a meaningful start.

❤️ Love: Emotional intensity is heightened, and surface harmony may feel insufficient. You’re more aware of unspoken expectations or subtle patterns around trust and vulnerability. If partnered, honest conversations about shared finances, emotional labour, or lingering resentments can move things toward greater honesty—if both sides stay curious rather than defensive. If single, powerful attractions are possible, but take time to observe how potential partners handle responsibility and transparency.

💰 Money: The 8th-house emphasis puts joint accounts, loans, inheritances, taxes, or subscription-style payments on the table. Mars can bring urgency to deal with something; Jupiter suggests that improvements are possible if you’re willing to see the whole picture. The Virgo Sun in your 10th supports seeking expert advice or professional guidance where needed. Aim for arrangements that reduce long-term stress, not just short-term relief.

🧘 Advice: When confronting a sensitive topic, ask yourself first, “What am I truly afraid will happen if this changes?” Naming the fear makes the next step clearer.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Transforming how you share power and resources now can quietly reshape the kind of success you’re able to build later.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Ashlesha travels through your 7th house of one-to-one relationships, where Jupiter and Mars are already active. Across the sky, Saturn—your ruler—is retrograde in Pisces in Revati, and the Sun in Virgo continues to move through your 9th house of beliefs and direction. Partnerships and principles are in conversation today.

💼 Career: Collaborations, client relationships, and key professional alliances are highlighted. Mars can stir assertiveness or conflict; Jupiter offers the potential for growth through cooperation. Ashlesha’s influence means subtle undercurrents matter: pay attention to what people imply as much as what they say. Negotiations about timelines, responsibilities, or terms can move forward if you hold firm to your ethical standards (9th-house Sun) while staying open to creative solutions.

❤️ Love: Relationship themes are front and centre. You may feel more aware than usual of the ways your partner supports—or challenges—your long-term path. If partnered, meaningful conversations about shared philosophy, future plans, or spiritual interests can deepen your bond. If single, your desire for companionship may be strong, but you’re likely to be drawn to those whose worldview resonates with yours, not just those who seem impressive.

💰 Money: Joint finances, shared obligations, or business partnerships may need review. This is a suitable day to clarify who is responsible for what, whether in domestic life or professional ventures. The Virgo Sun in your 9th supports seeking advice from someone you respect or doing careful research before altering any major agreement. Written clarity now prevents confusion later.

🧘 Advice: In any negotiation, remember that your steadiness is more persuasive than any perfectly crafted argument. Don’t rush to fill every silence; let your position stand.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The partnerships that truly belong in your future are the ones where your principles don’t have to shrink to fit.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Ashlesha moves through your 6th house of work, health routines, and service, alongside Jupiter and Mars. Rahu continues its transit through your sign in Dhanishtha, and the Sun stays in Virgo in your 8th house. The sky presses you to examine both your daily habits and the deeper patterns that sit behind them.

💼 Career: Tasks and duties may pile up, but there’s strong support for improving how you handle them. Mars fuels productivity; Jupiter helps you see which efforts truly matter; Ashlesha gives you insight into subtle workplace dynamics. You might recognise where you overextend yourself or quietly take on what others avoid. The Virgo Sun in your 8th house favours honest assessment of unspoken expectations—consider adjusting boundaries or redistributing responsibilities where appropriate.

❤️ Love: Practical expressions of care speak loudest now. How you and a partner share chores, support each other’s wellbeing, and respect each other’s working rhythms will likely feel more significant than usual. If partnered, a calm, specific conversation about who does what—and how it feels—can be surprisingly bonding. If single, you may feel drawn to someone you meet in everyday settings or through service, health, or work-related environments.

💰 Money: Everyday expenses and deeper financial entanglements both come into view. The 6th-house focus highlights income tied to your labour and the costs of staying functional—transport, tools, health support. The 8th-house Sun suggests it’s also time to look at shared resources, debts, or subscriptions you’ve half-forgotten. Systematic review and a few small corrections can lighten background financial stress.

🧘 Advice: Don’t try to repair every habit at once. Choose one small, sustainable change that supports both your body and your schedule, and honour it consistently for the next week.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The freedom you value so highly is built, day by day, on the routines you’re willing to refine.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Cancer Moon in Ashlesha lights up your 5th house of creativity, romance, and self-expression, joining Jupiter (your traditional ruler) and Mars there. Saturn retrograde in your sign continues its deeper restructuring work, while the Sun in Virgo activates your 7th house of partnerships. Today’s sky blends play and seriousness, invitation and commitment.

💼 Career: Even in practical roles, you’re being nudged to bring more originality and heart into what you do. Projects involving design, storytelling, presentation, or any form of performance are favoured, especially if they involve collaboration (7th-house Sun). With Ashlesha’s probing quality, you can sense what kind of message will actually resonate with your audience or clients. Don’t underestimate the professional value of your imaginative ideas.

❤️ Love: This is a rich day for matters of the heart. The 5th-house focus can heighten attraction, desire for fun, and the urge to be seen for who you really are. At the same time, the Sun in your 7th asks, “What kind of partnership can hold this joy over time?” If partnered, blend romance with realism: discuss how you can protect time for enjoyment together amidst responsibilities. If single, encounters today may feel fated or intensely absorbing; let things unfold at a human pace rather than rushing toward definitions.

💰 Money: Creative talents and relationships are both tied to your financial picture now. You may glimpse ways to monetise a passion, propose a collaborative offering, or negotiate terms that reflect the true scope of what you provide. However, Mars in the 5th can also tempt you into generous or impulsive spending on leisure, hobbies, or loved ones. A clear limit set in advance will help you enjoy without regret.

🧘 Advice: When inspiration flickers, capture it—a note, a sketch, a voice memo—before doubts settle in. You can refine later; today is about honouring the spark.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Taking your joy seriously doesn’t mean turning it into pressure; it means recognising it as a real force shaping the life you’re building with others.
